coverage.search_result_binding: Search engine returned result groups per batch; per-result assignment to individual queries is not asserted where the tool did not expose it. See unresolved.json for inspected candidates and exclusion reasons.
limitations: Only 12 targeted public-index queries were run; the 2029-query manifest was not exhausted.
A public-index no-result does not establish that an article does not exist or is not accessible through WeChat search.
No course evaluation inside Fudan's authenticated teaching-evaluation system was accessed.

Two focused Edge/Sogou WeChat UI queries were submitted. One returned a result that was opened and fully read; the second query (复旦 社会学导论 吴菲) was submitted, but its result state remained unread after two browser observation timeouts. This partial UI check is not exhaustive.
